title: [CRITICAL] SQL injection in order search via unescaped sort column
description:
**File:** [`src/api/orders/search.ts`](https://github.com/acme/shop/blob/main/src/api/orders/search.ts#L41-L48) (lines 41, 44, 48)
**Project:** shop
**Severity:** CRITICAL  •  **Confidence:** high  •  **Slug:** `sql-injection`

## Owners

**Suggested assignee:** `oncall@acme.example` _(via oncall)_

**Teams:**
- Checkout (`checkout`)

**Current on-call:**
- Dana Oncall <oncall@acme.example> • [@dana](https://github.com/dana)

## Finding

The `sort` query parameter is interpolated into the ORDER BY clause of a raw SQL string, so a request such as `?sort=id;DROP TABLE orders` runs attacker-chosen SQL with the service's database role.

## Recommendation

Map `sort` to an allowlist of column names and pass values as bound parameters.

## Revalidation

**Verdict:** true-positive

The handler is reachable without authentication from /api/orders/search.

title: [HIGH] Missing authorization check on invoice download <script>alert(1)</script>
description:
**File:** `src/api/invoices/[id].ts` (lines 12)
**Project:** shop
**Severity:** HIGH  •  **Confidence:** medium  •  **Slug:** `missing-authz`

## Finding

Any signed-in user can download another customer's invoice by changing the id.‮

## Recommendation

Check that the invoice's customer_id is the session's customer.

title: [MEDIUM] Open redirect after sign-in
description:
**File:** `src/auth/callback.ts` (lines 30)
**Project:** shop
**Severity:** MEDIUM  •  **Confidence:** low  •  **Slug:** `open-redirect`

## Finding

The `next` parameter is used as the redirect target without checking its host.

## Recommendation

Only accept relative paths.

## Revalidation

**Verdict:** false-positive

The middleware in src/auth/guard.ts strips absolute URLs before this handler runs.

revalidation.reasoning: The middleware in src/auth/guard.ts strips absolute URLs before this handler runs.

title: [HIGH_BUG] Refund job can run twice for one order
description:
**File:** `src/jobs/refund.ts` (lines 77, 90)
**Project:** shop
**Severity:** HIGH_BUG  •  **Confidence:** medium  •  **Slug:** `other-race-condition`

## Finding

Two workers can pick up the same refund because the status check and update are not atomic.

## Recommendation

Claim the row with UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'pending' RETURNING.
